findings.problem: D8.flow consumer chips use 22 px text and the broker queue chips 26 px: below the 28 px rule (m1..m5 hard to read).
findings.fix: Chips 56 px wide with 28 px text in both rows; on short cards (two rigs per stage) 40 px high and 2 px lower so they clear the icon.

findings.problem: D8.floodLane producer/consumer discs '6/s' and '4/s' use 24 px text.
findings.fix: Discs 64 px with 28 px text; slots start at x 298 to make room.

findings.problem: floodLane's name pill ('Backpressure') runs into the producer disc; scene 6 hid it via DOM child index and drew its own label.
findings.fix: Helper draws the name as plain 30 px text ending well left of the disc; scene 6 hack removed.

findings.problem: Counter bump reached into the lane's DOM (lastElementChild, regex on textContent) and re-placed it at a hard-coded x 292.
findings.fix: floodLane.set takes countS (counter scale) and exposes lane.count; scene 6 uses them and draws lanes straight on the stage.

findings.problem: The orange 'm4 before m3' arrow is thin and small, easy to miss.
Empty band between the consumer cards and the key row; the key row sits low.
findings.fix: Key row moved from y 580 to y 500 so the figure is centred.

findings.problem: Recap rows 2 and 3 show an unlabelled purple box; row 3 is tight (m3 disc touches the wire end and the consumer).
findings.fix: Purple 'broker' label under each box; row 3 broker moved left, consumers right, m3 stops 60 px short, ack and bolt follow.

findings.problem: 'deleted once delivered' floats between the two rigs next to 'lost to B', not on the broker it describes.
findings.fix: Tag moved to sit just above the lower broker card.

findings.problem: Pushed-to consumer cards turn blue (the event/producer role) instead of green (delivered).
During the polling part the rig sits low and the top third of the stage is empty.
findings.fix: Leave: the top fills with the three consumers in the push part; restaging would mean a rewrite.

findings.problem: Checked all figures against ds-l8-01..03: 4,000/2,500/3,500 lines, views per page, mo_17 like 4821 at 09:15:02 and unlike at 09:20:41, 720 checks / 12 events / 708 empty, 6/s vs 4/s: 20 waiting, 14 dropped, 46 of 60 sent, m1..m4 offline story, 4 vs 8 deliveries, C1 processes m2 m4 m3 m5. All consistent and asserted in helpers.
Greps for white/#fff/gradient/blur/filter/Math.random/Date/timers clean; same frames rendered in two orders give identical md5; eslint and prettier clean; 124.5 s, no page errors.
